checkpointExpired.title: Checkpoint expired
checkpointExpired.body: A checkpoint on run #{{runNumber}} "{{taskTitle}}" in {{projectName}} expired without a response.

runTimedOut.body: Run #{{runNumber}} "{{taskTitle}}" in {{projectName}} exceeded its duration limit.

runtimeOffline.title: Runtime offline
runtimeOffline.body: The remote runtime “{{runtimeName}}” executing run #{{runNumber}} “{{taskTitle}}” in {{projectName}} has stopped reporting.

scheduleDisabled.body: The schedule “{{scheduleName}}” in {{projectName}} was disabled and will not run again: {{reason}}.

scheduleFailed.title: Schedule could not run
scheduleFailed.body: The schedule “{{scheduleName}}” in {{projectName}} produced no run this time: {{error}}. It stays enabled and will try again.

triggerDisabled.title: Trigger stopped
triggerDisabled.body: The webhook trigger “{{triggerName}}” in {{projectName}} was disabled and will accept nothing further: {{reason}}.

triggerFailed.title: Trigger could not run
triggerFailed.body: A request to the webhook trigger “{{triggerName}}” in {{projectName}} produced no run: {{error}}. The sender was already acknowledged, so nobody else will hear about this.
